assertions.name: no_unregistered_package_prefixes
assertions.source: Every lean.ref prefix must appear in LEAN_PACKAGES (folio-assistant/cat-harness/schemas/lean-packages.ts).

assertions.name: ok_count_matches_total_minus_failures
assertions.source: Closure gate: when this passes, every content-block lean.ref resolves to an actual declaration.  Currently informational; the production-side fix is a follow-up PR per the watcher's §5j spawn protocol.

description: I12 audit per local/compute-integration-watcher: walk every content/.../*.ts content-block file with a `lean.ref` URI of the form `<package>:<Decl.Path>` and attempt the 3-step resolution the export pipeline performs (sibling → Lake-root → grep). Classifies each as `ok` or one of six failure modes. Operationalises the 305-hit I12 count from the 2026-05-18 idle sweep (PR #737).
